title: Response
description: Types the data payload flowing through HTTP Effectors/Receptors when the payload is an HTTP response message. Extending archetypes add domain-specific body shapes and additional headers via $ref/allOf composition. Source: RFC 9110 (HTTP Semantics, 2022), §3.4 — Messages, §15 — Status Codes.

statusCode.description: The specific 3-digit HTTP status code (e.g., 200, 404, 503). Source: RFC 9110 §15 — Status Codes.

contentType.description: Media type of the response payload body (IANA media type, e.g., 'application/json'). Source: RFC 9110 §8.3 — Content-Type.

body.description: Response message content. At protocol level, unconstrained; extending archetypes constrain this to a domain-specific shape via $ref/allOf composition. Source: RFC 9110 §6.4 — Content.
